sources.title: Visual Question Answering: From Early Developments to Recent Advances ...
sources.snippet: Visual-Attention: Guided attention refers to the use of an attention mechanism to help the model focus on specific parts of an image when generating an answer to a question about the image. The attention mechanism is guided by the question, which is used as a query to direct the model's attention to relevant regions of the image.

sources.title: CVPR 2026 Open Access Repository
sources.snippet: Leveraging web-scale deployment, this pipeline crawls a massive amount of ~1.8M high-quality, interleaved image-text samples for model training. For evaluation, we further release IntelligentBench, a human-curated benchmark that systematically assesses VQ-VA along the aspects of world knowledge, design knowledge, and reasoning.
